<!-- started: 2026-11-11 -->
<!-- resolved: 2026-11-12 -->

Vercel paused the hovanhoa.net team after it went over the **Hobby plan's fair-use limits**, so every site answered with a "deployment paused" page instead of its content.

- **Nov 11** · Vercel pauses deployments and every *.hovanhoa.net site goes offline.
- **Nov 12** · Each site is rebuilt as a static export and moved to **Cloudflare Workers**, then DNS is switched over one site at a time.
- **Nov 12** · Live data is back: Spotify on music, analytics on insight and the latest posts on the home page refresh from small Worker APIs.

All sites are now served from Cloudflare's edge. Nothing changes for visitors.
title: Sites offline after Vercel paused the team; moved to Cloudflare
